svg.aria-label: Blaž Čulina. Software Engineer at Sportradar, formerly NSoft. Java, Spring Boot, AI, Cloud. Contribution grid, one row per year since 2022, refreshed daily. Portrait in halftone dots. About: Software engineer at Sportradar (formerly NSoft), based between Imotski, Croatia and Mostar, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Pragmatic backend specialist: four years of production Java, Spring Boot and Kubernetes behind real-time iGaming products, where a wrong answer costs money. Around that core I cover a lot of ground. Having grown up around computers, I like knowing how things actually work under the hood rather than treating systems and tools as black boxes. I'm also easy to work with and get on well with people across teams. Experience. Full-time: Sportradar (formerly NSoft), Mostar. Software Engineer, August 2022 to now, four years and counting. iGaming and Platforms team, hybrid. Architected, built and maintained backend services for six real-time products end to end, used 24/7 and handling up to a million transactions a day with 99.9% uptime, all certified by independent testing labs. Maintained and developed a critical legacy PHP system: a 24/7 data feed distributing to 100+ B2B clients worldwide, acting as their main point of contact and first escalation point for outages. Built a certifiable, tamper-proof random number generator library to GLI lab standards, verified against NIST reference data. Developed the team's custom Kubernetes operator (Java Operator SDK), which automates deploying and configuring services. Led the migration of core components from a PHP/Symfony monolith to microservices, upgraded legacy services to current Spring Boot and Java, and consulted on design and product architecture decisions. Brought AI coding agents and harnesses into the team's workflow, and built internal skills the whole team uses for library releases, service integrations, code rules and service knowledge. Freelance, part-time alongside the role. Backend: VyFinance, Cardano DEX, account layer, Jun–Aug 2025; TMinusOne, Cardano launchpad, core REST API, Mar–May 2025. Web: Websites, for clients, over the years; Custom-built webshops, with client-specific features. Technical scope, deepest areas first. Backend: Java 17–25, Spring Boot, PHP/Symfony, service design. AI tooling: Claude Code, Oh My Pi, OpenSpec, Superpowers. Planning: Scoping, specs, shipping. Platform: Kubernetes, k3s, Helm, Docker, Podman, Jenkins. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS. Systems: Linux, Bash, Python for tooling, Rust at patch level. Blockchain: Cardano, Blockfrost, from two contracts. Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, a deliberate focus for 2026. Elsewhere. Open source: Patches upstream when something I use is broken or missing: GitHub Copilot CLI support for obra/superpowers (#910), and an icon-rendering fix for pop-os/freedesktop-icons (Rust), shipped in Pop!_OS (#9). Homelab: Self-hosted Kubernetes on a private network, partly on Raspberry Pis, for testing configuration and behaviour before it reaches anything that matters. Education: BSc in Computer Science, University of Mostar, FSRE, thesis: distributed speech recognition processing on a Raspberry Pi cluster. Languages: Croatian (native), English (full professional), German (limited working). Otherwise: Tinkering with hardware and software, making music, exploring side projects.
